content:
With most WhatsApp users on iOS now officially receiving the Liquid Glass redesign, the messaging app is testing another visual change, this time focusing on the look of chat bubbles. Here are the details.

The new chat bubbles look a little rounder

A few months ago, WhatsApp finally began rolling out the Liquid Glass redesign more widely, after months of testing and refinement with select users via TestFlight.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted references to a redesign of WhatsApp chat bubbles in the app's code. Now, the site reports that the new bubbles have begun rolling out to some users running the latest TestFlight build.

Here's the report from WABetaInfo:

In addition to changing the shape of message bubbles, the new design also changes how media and links are displayed in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green outline surrounding them, making photos, videos, GIFs, and link previews look cleaner and more cohesive.

According to WABetaInfo, the new look is available to some users running the WhatsApp TestFlight build. It remains unknown when it will be rolled out more broadly to all iOS users.
